source: This release is to be used for the beta test of segment #1. Segments The game's planned content has been divided into approximately twelve segments, plus or minus three segments. Each segment contains a portion of story, some new gameplay mechanics, and other content. Our development philosophy involves creating each segment, testing it internally for balance, and then beta testing it for further polish, balance, and review. This allows us to continually assess & expand the game in a controlled manner. Thank you for being part of the Beta Test!
target: 這個版本供第一階段 Beta 測試使用。 開發階段 我們將規劃中的遊戲內容分成約十二個階段，可能增減三個。每個階段包含一部分故事、新玩法機制及其他內容。我們的開發理念是：逐一建立各階段，先進行內部平衡測試，再透過 Beta 測試進一步修潤、調整平衡與檢視。如此便能在可控的情況下，持續評估及擴充遊戲。 感謝你參與 Beta 測試！

source: The sun winks through the pines, scattering beams on the ferns below. Retired couples, active parents, and idle minds wander peacefully along the many trails. They move like monorails, never deviating, making scheduled stops to open their eyelids and peer out at a sequence of views and vistas. Creatures of the pines avoid the monorail of humans, and live hard lives of competition with the other creatures.
